topic: Saving Electrical Energy and Energy Sources
key_concepts: Electrical energy consumption is calculated as power rating multiplied by time.
Electrical energy consumption is measured in kilowatt-hours.
Electricity cost is computed by multiplying kilowatt-hours by the rate per kilowatt-hour.
Reducing usage time of high-power appliances lowers electrical energy consumption.
Renewable energy sources are readily available and cannot be depleted.
Non-renewable energy sources can be depleted through excessive use.
Hydroelectric, wind, and geothermal power plants use renewable energy sources.
Coal, diesel, and nuclear power plants use non-renewable energy sources.
